[[Lou's Karambits]] are a set of [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] dropped by [[Lou, of the Knives]] in [[Shenzun Tunnels]] or [[Wajjun Bazaar]] (only during [[Deactivating P.O.X.]]) or by [[Waeng]] in [[The Undercity]] (only during [[Assist the Guards]]).

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 7-17 (requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while in a [[Stance]])
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as [[Korambits]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Korambits]] from collectors [[Shaan]] or [[Kilgor Rageheart]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Dagger Tang]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Dagger Handle]] [[of Fortitude]]


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*[[Butterfly Knives]] from collectors [[Kiishen]], [[Jaun Stumi]], or [[Catrine Embolom]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Dagger Tang]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Dagger Handle]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following sets of [[dagger]]s:
**[[Asuran Daggers]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Daggers]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Norn Daggers]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Split Chakrams]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Charr Daggers]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Tengu Daggers]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Dagger Tang]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Dagger Handle]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Dance with Death]]" inscription

*Use one of the following sets of daggers with the appropriate [[Dagger Tang]] and [[Dagger Handle]]:

**[[Crude Daggers]] from collectors [[Tanni Silvermane]] and [[Ivarr Stewbrewer]]
**[[Dirks]] from collectors [[Denos Makaluum]] or [[Elder Pomona]]
OR
*Use one of the following sets of daggers with the appropriate [[Dagger Tang]], [[Dagger Handle]], and [[Inscription]]:
**[[Bronze Daggers]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Deldrimor Daggers]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Oppressor's Daggers]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Mursaat Daggers]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Undead Daggers]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
